title: Internal: reversing a billed annual fee on a credit card
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: annual fee reversal tool

This operations reference covers refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99, the internal tool of the Personal Credit Cards line that takes a billed annual fee back off a cardholder's credit card.

## Situation of use and capability

The agent uses this tool to reverse one billed annual fee on a credit card account in full and to record the ground for the reversal. One call posts one fee-reversal credit entry on the card account, linked to the annual fee it cancels and carrying the reversal ground, in the statement cycle that is open today. The card's current balance owed goes down by the reversed amount at once, and the cardholder sees the credit on the card activity immediately. The tool posts the values it is given; it does not itself check whether the fee qualifies, the window or the amount.

## How it is invoked

refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): the agent unlocks it with unlock_agent_discoverable_tool and calls it with call_agent_discoverable_tool. The agent performs the call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| customer_id | the customer reference number of the cardholder whose fee is reversed, as returned by the customer profile lookup | reference number text |
| card_account_id | the reference number of the credit card account that was billed the annual fee, as returned by the card account lookup | reference number text |
| source_item_id | the reference number of the annual fee entry being reversed, as returned by the card activity lookup for that account | reference number text |
| amount | the amount reversed | USD, a positive number rounded half-up to 2 decimal places; never empty for this call |
| adjustment_reason | the ground on which the annual fee is reversed | exactly one of the values below |

Allowed values of adjustment_reason:

- bank_error: the fee must not stand under the card charter, for example it is refunded because the card is closed inside the refund window or a waiver excluded it.
- courtesy_waiver: a courtesy reversal; never valid for an annual fee, because courtesy reversals apply only to late payment fees.
- dispute_final: the fee was billed on a disputed charge resolved for the cardholder; never the case for an annual fee.
- none: no ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.
- dispute_provisional: a temporary billing-dispute credit ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.
- scra_benefit: a military rate cap interest ground; never valid for a fee reversal and not to be used.

## Return

A text rendering of a dictionary with: status (always "reversed" when the posting succeeded), card_txn_id (the new fee-reversal entry), card_account_id, reversed_fee_id (the annual fee entry reversed), amount (USD, 2 decimal places, the credit posted), adjustment_reason (the ground recorded), statement_cycle (YYYY-MM, the cycle the reversal posted in), posted_date (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and new_current_balance (the balance owed after the reversal). The call is complete when the receipt comes back with status "reversed"; the tool defines no error outcome.

## Contract Q&A

**Q: Which grounds does the tool describe as valid for an annual fee?**
A: Only bank_error; the tool describes every other value as never valid for an annual fee reversal.

**Q: Does one call reverse more than one fee?**
A: No. One call posts one reversal entry, linked to the one annual fee entry named in source_item_id.
